method: Static checks by reading the concept source plus live headless-browser verification against the real shared modules.

static_checks.check: no href/src referencing concept-01..04 or sibling concepts
virtualization present: PMManagers2.virtualList on #/all with rowHeight 64 and data-window updates
no scope selectors (Global/Project/Goal/Host), no inheritance, no profiles/sync UI
no emoji; icons only via PMIcons
no left accent bars; colors only via var(--token)
reduced motion: [data-reduced-motion=1] kills pane-transfer and skeleton animations
search rows carry data-rid and .pm2-r-title; routing via PMSearch2.byRid only
test hooks present: data-test=search-input/search-results/back/close/home/all/copy/vlist; data-route on root view; data-manager on every manager section; data-window on vlist host

live_checks.check: home renders: 12 browse-by-area destinations with counts, notices, utilities, recent
search 'context window': grouped dropdown; duplicate Context Window rows with distinct paths
select setting row: About-this-setting card + row focused + .pm2-locate
browser Back: #/q/<query> with input restored and dropdown reopened with same rows
all 47 manager routes: [data-manager], [data-test=back], [data-test=breadcrumb], [data-test=close] present; data-route correct
#/all: data-window 0:18:828 then 306:331:828 and 806:828:828 on scroll; synthetic toggle -> 2828; facet ai -> 112
copy flow: counts (828/124/414/283/0/0) + diff + apply -> verified -> rollback available
squeezed tier: nav drawer, facets drawer, roster push, Escape order verified
scenarios: managed/unavailable/restart/changed-elsewhere badges on real rows; offline banner; usage-unavailable note without bar
ops strip: determinate progress with counts and cancel during copy apply; removed on completion

known_limitations: Manager-local fixture rows are demo values from PMManagers2Data, not inventory rows by design.
Concept is a prototype; no canonical Plans/catalog changes.
Background-tab throttling of rAF/scroll/ResizeObserver is compensated with concept-level timers (scroll polling, tier polling); visible behavior in a foreground tab is identical.
